name: fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker
description: Fieldtrip webinar-lead LinkedIn tracker: one shared Notion page of lead lists, checked against each user's LinkedIn inbox, read-only.

plugins.name: fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker
plugins.description: /fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker: Reads the shared Webinar Leads Notion page, then checks your LinkedIn inbox (read-only) for conversations with anyone on its lead lists. Marks who connected and replied, @mentions you on new replies, and logs the run. Never sends anything on LinkedIn.
